descriptions.autumnleaves.html: Red, orange, and yellow leaves tumble across the screen and gather into a loose pile along the bottom.
descriptions.blob.html: Soft, rounded color blobs swell and overlap, forming slow, liquid-like shapes.
descriptions.bounce.html: A glowing rounded-square mark bounces across the screen, squashing and stretching at each impact.
descriptions.bubbles.html: Translucent bubbles of different sizes float upward and pop against a dark background.
descriptions.circuitboard.html: Glowing right-angled traces form a branching circuit pattern as bright pulses travel along the paths.
descriptions.city.html: A layered city skyline with lit windows sits beneath a sky that shifts between dusk and night.
descriptions.constellation.html: Small glowing stars drift and connect with thin lines, forming shifting constellations.
descriptions.cymatics.html: Thousands of tiny points gather into symmetrical wave patterns that slowly morph from one shape to another.
descriptions.fireworks.html: Bright bursts of colored sparks bloom, scatter, and fade across a dark sky.
descriptions.flow.html: Fine glowing particles trace curved, flowing paths that fade into the background.
descriptions.gameoflife.html: A grid of glowing cells grows and changes in clusters, leaving shifting gaps of dark space.
descriptions.glitch.html: Colorful geometric shapes slide and rotate beneath brief bands of visual distortion.
descriptions.kaleidoscope.html: Glowing circular motifs repeat in mirrored wedges, slowly rotating into kaleidoscopic patterns.
descriptions.lanterns.html: Glowing paper lanterns drift upward beneath a field of twinkling stars.
descriptions.magnetic-field-lines.html: Curving luminous paths loop around shifting points while tiny particles follow the lines.
descriptions.metaphysical-horizon.html: Seven soft pools of colored light overlap and slowly pulse across a dark field.
descriptions.n-body-galaxies.html: Two dense star systems swirl toward one another, their glowing stars leaving faint trails.
descriptions.organic-harmonic-field.html: Layered bands of color bend and ripple into a flowing, organic wave pattern.
descriptions.origami.html: A grid of diamond-shaped tiles slowly flips between two colors.
descriptions.papercranes.html: A flock of folded paper cranes glides across a softly shaded sky, their wings gently flapping.
descriptions.quantum-interference.html: Overlapping circular waves create shifting bands of light around several moving points.
descriptions.rain-on-a-window.html: Water droplets bead and slide down a glass-like surface in front of softly blurred lights.
descriptions.rain.html: Slanting rain streaks cross a dark sky, punctuated by brief flashes of lightning.
descriptions.sakura.html: Cherry-blossom petals drift and turn slowly across the screen.
descriptions.soft-body-creatures.html: Soft, translucent blobs wobble, stretch, and drift as their rounded outlines change shape.
descriptions.solar-system.html: A bright central sun anchors orbiting planets, with faint star clouds and compact spaceflight readouts.
descriptions.starfield.html: A sparse field of stars drifts across layered, softly glowing nebula clouds.
descriptions.strange-attractor-flow.html: Glowing particles curl through a continuously twisting, looped pattern, leaving fading trails.
descriptions.typewriter.html: Lines of text appear one character at a time on a dark screen, followed by a blinking cursor.
descriptions.voronoi.html: A shifting mosaic of irregular polygon cells fills the screen with softly glowing edges.
descriptions.wave-function-collapse.html: A grid of glowing line segments, corners, and junctions gradually resolves into a connected pattern, then fades.
